title: decodeSearchRows: shared decoder bridging RESOURCE_TABLE and FIELD_VALUES search responses
answers: Where is search response decoding handled for folder registry searches?
How to decode a ResourceSearchResponse that could be RESOURCE_TABLE or FIELD_VALUES?
Compatibility with older servers still returning RESOURCE_TABLE
body: pkg/registry/apis/folders/sub_children.go:decodeSearchRows() is the shared decoder for resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse used by cascade_delete_storage.go, sub_children.go, and validate.go. It switches on response.GetResultFormat(): RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED reads Results.Rows/Columns (old servers), FIELD_VALUES reads response.Rows via resource.DecodeSearchValues(response.Fields, row) (new servers). Any new folder registry search call should reuse this helper instead of hand-rolling row extraction, to stay compatible across server versions during rollout.
applies: Folder registry code (pkg/registry/apis/folders) consuming ResourceIndexClient.Search responses.
